"Build and navigate the hierarchy used to organize the report dictionary."

SortByColumns(
    Filter(colNodes, LevelNo = 1 && IsActive),
    "SortOrder", SortOrder.Ascending,
    "DisplayName", SortOrder.Ascending
)

SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        colNodes,
        LevelNo = 2 &&
        IsActive &&
        Text(ParentNodeId) = Text(varSelNodeId_L1)
    ),
    "SortOrder", SortOrder.Ascending,
    "DisplayName", SortOrder.Ascending
)

SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        colNodes,
        LevelNo = 3 &&
        IsActive &&
        Text(ParentNodeId) = Text(varSelNodeId_L2)
    ),
    "SortOrder", SortOrder.Ascending,
    "DisplayName", SortOrder.Ascending
)

If(
    IsBlank(galL1_1.Selected.NodeId) && IsBlank(galL2_1.Selected.NodeId) && IsBlank(galL3_1.Selected.NodeId),
    "Select a node to manage it",
    "You can edit or deactivate the current selection"
)
"Config data is not loaded. Click 'Load Config Data' to continue."

If(
    !IsBlank(varTargetSubsectionId) && CountRows(colAssignedForTarget) > 0,
    "Ready for review",
    "No scope assigned"
)
"No groups assigned to this subsection yet."

Set(varCfg_Error, "");

IfError(
    With(
        { r: WarRoom_ReportDictionary_Get.Run(varProjectId) },
        ClearCollect(
            colReportDictionary,
            ForAll(
                Table(ParseJSON(Coalesce(r.result, "[]"))),
                {
                    HeaderNodeId: Text(Value.HeaderNodeId),
                    Header: Text(Value.Header),
                    HeaderSort: Value(Value.HeaderSort),

                    SectionNodeId: Text(Value.SectionNodeId),
                    Section: Text(Value.Section),
                    SectionSort: Value(Value.SectionSort),

                    SubsectionNodeId: Text(Value.SubsectionNodeId),
                    Subsection: Text(Value.Subsection),
                    SubsectionSort: Value(Value.SubsectionSort),

                    SqlKey: Text(Value.SqlKey),
                    GridKey: Text(Value.GridKey),

                    Total: Value(Value.Total),
                    Done: If(IsBlank(Text(Value.Done)), Blank(), Value(Value.Done)),
                    Pending: If(IsBlank(Text(Value.Pending)), Blank(), Value(Value.Pending))
                }
            )
        )
    ),
    Set(varCfg_Error, "Error loading report dictionary.")
);

Set(varCfg_Error, "");

IfError(
    With(
        { r: WarRoom_ReportDictionary_MapDebug.Run(varProjectId) },
        ClearCollect(
            colReportMapDebug,
            ForAll(
                Table(ParseJSON(Coalesce(r.result, "[]"))),
                {
                    GroupKey: Text(Value.GroupKey),

                    ElementDiscipline: Text(Value.ElementDiscipline),
                    ElementLevel: Text(Value.ElementLevel),
                    PhaseName: Text(Value.PhaseName),
                    FormName: Text(Value.FormName),
                    FormDescription: Text(Value.FormDescription),

                    Sct: Boolean(Value.Sct),
                    MasterTask: Boolean(Value.MasterTask),
                    DossierTask: Boolean(Value.DossierTask),

                    TotalInspections: Value(Value.TotalInspections),

                    Header: Text(Value.Header),
                    Section: Text(Value.Section),
                    Subsection: Text(Value.Subsection),
                    SqlKey: Text(Value.SqlKey),
                    GridKey: Text(Value.GridKey),
                    SubsectionNodeId: Text(Value.SubsectionNodeId)
                }
            )
        )
    ),
    Set(varCfg_Error, "Error loading report mapping debug.")
);

If(varEditMode="NEW",
   "Create Level " & varEditLevel & " Node",
   "Edit Level " & varEditLevel & " Node")

If(
    varEditMode = "NEW",
    "Creating Level " & Text(varEditLevel) &
    If(
        varEditLevel = 1,
        " (root node)",
        " under parent: " &
        Coalesce(
            LookUp(colNodes, Text(NodeId) = Text(varEditParentNodeId), DisplayName),
            "-"
        )
    ),
    "Editing: " &
    Coalesce(
        LookUp(colNodes, Text(NodeId) = Text(varEditNodeId), DisplayName),
        "-"
    )
)
